description:
Observability adapters for the framework-agnostic Pathland server runtime: a
        Micrometer PathlandTelemetry (pathland.* counters/timers + a sessions gauge) and an
        opt-in OpenTelemetry TracingTelemetry decorator (spans per frame send / event
        batch / SSR render). The starters auto-wire these when a MeterRegistry/Tracer bean
        is present; without them the core stays on PathlandTelemetry.NOOP.
